decision: Analog Rytm MKII module: rytm2_mods' elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0012-slice-loop, for OS 1.74, imported under GPL-2.0-only with attribution. rytm-mods-src is published with MrScruff's permission.

transformations: mod.json's OS 1.74 port site (0x400f9f02, 6 stock bytes, jmp slice_loop_menu_add) became an address, length and SHA-256 guard in build.json's 1.74 release.
The OS 1.73 source and site are not imported: core-ar2 0.3 is for OS 1.74 only.
include/ar2-1.74.inc keeps its path relative to the source, so the .include line in src/slice-loop.s is unchanged.
